subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “An old hand-drawn map showed large trees that once lined a city street.”?
options: Students also planted three young trees nearby.
Others, like jobs, safety, and education, remained familiar.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Today, schedules happened automatically.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students also planted three young trees nearby.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Others, like jobs, safety, and education, remained familiar.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Today, only three remained.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
